text: observed statistic Frobenius norm producer j's classification image mask, optionally restricted logical mask (e.g. oval face region via make_face_mask()):   reference distribution producer j built simulating iter random masks trial count trial_counts[j], mirroring Schmitz, Rougier, & Yzerbyt (2024)'s genMask() construction: Sample trial_counts[j] stimulus ids uniformly 1:n_pool (without replacement trial_counts[j] <= n_pool). Sample trial_counts[j] responses uniformly {-1, +1} (always replacement). Collapse response stim via mean(). Build mask: noise_matrix[, unique_stims] %*% mean_response / n_unique_stims. Apply mask (supplied) compute Frobenius norm. Per-producer z-score: (norm_j - median(ref)) / mad(ref). Producers sharing trial count share reference; makes simulation efficient. Brief-RC producer's recorded n_trials typically smaller n_pool, pool-size reference biases infoVal downward. infoval() closes gap keying reference actual per-producer recorded trial count. infoVal measures (). Frobenius norm magnitude statistic, target-alignment one. Cross-paradigm comparisons need care; stability discriminability different questions call rel_split_half() / rel_icc() / rel_cluster_test() / rel_dissimilarity().
